messages:
Leila: quick async check — v2 cutover is still on track for Fri EOD but I need owners to confirm gating deps (SDK, proxy header, canary windows, rollback plan). pinging primary owners.
Sam: SDK PRs are open: `sdk-js#452`, `sdk-py#198`. failing tests in serializer suite, investigating.
Tori: Canary windows look good from product side. Standup tomorrow at 10am will cover traffic slices. :white_check_mark:
Marta: proxy header change (x-rdwd-auth) is blocked by eng-infra routing rule. I can push a hotfix today but need a signed-off config from infra. @andrew any ETA?
Andrew: infra will finish the rule by 2pm PST. I'll post the change and tag infra-owner.
Sam: re: serializer tests — failing case is multiline embeddings. I have a small patch, but need a quick CR. @Ria can you eyeball?
Ria: on it. I can pair at 11:30. Also added a quick smoke curl for the header case: `curl -H "x-rdwd-auth: token-TEST" -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by Andrew for 2024-06-15T14:00Z (staging). ID: deploy-20240615-42.
Sam: thanks @Ria — will push patch and request CR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sdks/pull/452
Marta: once infra confirms, I'll cut the hotfix branch and coordinate a short canary (5% traffic) for 30m, then expand.
Leila: summary: infra rule by 2pm (Andrew), SDK serializer patch + CR by 12pm (Sam + Ria), Marta to cut hotfix and run 30m canary. If all green, we proceed with cutover Fri EOD. If any blocker remains at 4pm Fri, fallback plan is to keep v1 route active and post rollback notice.
Sam: ack. i'll update the PR and add test case.
Ria: ack, pairing 11:30 — will merge if green. :thumbsup:
Andrew: posted infra change and @marta tagged. link: https://internal.redwood.ai/infra/changes/789
Leila: thanks everyone. if anything slips, drop updates here. otherwise will publish rollout checklist after canary passes.
